about.headline: A Baltimore kitchen, kept simple.
paragraphs: The Kale Company serves fresh, plant-forward food in Baltimore, Maryland. This paragraph is placeholder copy and should be replaced with the client's own story.

This site is a straightforward way to browse a menu, place a pickup or delivery order, and pay by card or at pickup. Delivery is handled by the restaurant's own driver. Grill Hearty's is a separate project and is not part of this website.
Real photos, hours, menu items, prices, and the pickup address will be swapped in as soon as the client provides them. Until then, everything you see here is clearly marked as a placeholder.
